<function name="SuppressEngineLighting" parent="render" type="libraryfunc">
	<description>
Allows suppressing model lighting for any upcoming model render operation.  
Lighting then can be manually set up via various functions such as <page>render.SetModelLighting</page>.

<bug issue="4070">This does not affect <page>IMesh</page>es.</bug>
	</description>
	<realm>Client</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="suppressLighting" type="boolean">True to suppress false to enable.</arg>
	</args>
</function>
